description: LATE BOX ARRIVALS 4 - WHERE HE RUNS. vf6 0x143dfc670 places the run target at targetZ = ball.z + sign(dz) * clamp(|dz|, 6.5, 12) on the attacking line taken from the team line table (teamAI + 0x44 + 20*side). The 12 m clamp keeps the runner in a near-post corridor. Widening it to 20 m lets him attack the back post / far side of the six-yard box on a cross. Second site lowers the 6.5 m floor to 5 so a central cut-back arrival is still possible. Two disp32 re-aims onto existing pool cells.
